t_advice_summary_textbox.text: tall hats give the best return except red orbrown . if points are low its best idea to swap. its easy to miss the space bar so concentrate on not missing.

vb_textbox.text: tall hats can give more mushrooms. but I think choosing on the left yields better results than on the right. Also blue on the left is usually bad. I would go for choosing left usually and if you see brown or red on right choose left, but if you see them on left their good.
